UNSAFE_className.description:
**Use at your own risk:** Custom class names for specific elements. This should only be used as a
**last resort**. Using this may result in unexpected side effects.
More information in the [Customizing components Guide](https://atlantis.getjobber.com/guides/customizing-components).

andText.description: Whether to also center the text.

ariaAttributes.description: Standard HTML aria attributes. Accepts all standard HTML aria attributes.

as.description: The HTML tag to render the container as. Defaults to `div`.

dataAttributes.description: Standard HTML data attributes. Accepts anything in a {{"data-key":"value"}} format.

gutters.description: The amount of space between the content and the edges of the container.

maxWidth.description: The maximum width of the centered content.
